HII – Mission Technologies is seeking an Early Career Software Engineer to help develop and maintain software applications supporting national broadband initiatives, data analytics platforms, and telecommunications systems. The role contributes to secure, reliable software development and maintenance in support of communications infrastructure and national telecommunications missions.
Defense & Space
No H1B
Security Clearance Required
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Assist in the design, development, testing, and deployment of software solutions that support national telecommunications mission objectives
Work with senior engineers and product teams to translate requirements into technical tasks
Learn and apply secure coding practices and support compliance with cybersecurity standards
Support maintenance activities, bug fixes, and performance enhancements for existing applications
Contribute to basic documentation and participate in team knowledge‑sharing activities

LEVEL 1 - 0 years experience with Bachelors in related field with previous engineering internship experience

Foundational knowledge or coursework in at least one of the following: Python, MATLAB, Rust, Unreal Engine, or Azure Cloud/Windows desktop environments
Basic understanding of APIs, RESTful services, or software architecture concepts
Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET security clearance
